context: A uni intern interviews a manager about quality assurance
purpose: Teach: 担っ/書き込ん/専念/県警/整合/図り/出題/一律

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 品質管理、社内のどの部署が中心を担っているんですか。
lines.en: Which department internally takes the lead on quality control?
lines.style: Careful, respectful inquiry. Slight lean forward. Genuine curiosity underneath the formality—third hour of conversation energy. Not rushing through the question.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 品管チームが専念して取り組んでいます。
lines.en: The QA team handles that full-time.
lines.style: Warm and direct. Brief pause before answering—gathering the right words. Clear but not curt. The tone of someone who appreciates a good question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 外部監査の整合性は、どう図り出すんでしょうか。
lines.en: How do you make sure external audits stay aligned with that?
lines.style: Leaning into the problem. Thoughtful pacing. Genuinely trying to understand the mechanics—not performing knowledge he doesn't have. A small steadiness in his voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各種ガイドラインの一律適用と、書き込んできた記録の照合で進めます。
lines.en: We apply all the guidelines consistently and cross-check everything against our documented records.
lines.style: Patient explanation. Steady, methodical pace. Speaking to someone who will understand the detail. No condescension—clarity as respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 県警関連の届出も含まれるんですか。
lines.en: Does that include notifications to the prefectural police?
lines.style: Pressing gently. One eyebrow slightly raised—checking he's understood the full scope. Still respectful, but testing the edges of what he's been told.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、年に一度の出題用試験もあります。
lines.en: Yes. And there's an annual inspection-type test as well.
lines.style: Affirmative and complete. A small nod in the voice. Slight warmth—she recognizes he's asking the right questions. Closing one loop and opening the door for the next one.
